title: Constrained residual chamber

protocol.name: year2022_2023
protocol.test: the whole 2023 window (report only — never fitted, never selected on)
protocol.model note: the residual chamber stays a bounded shadow corrector: the governor is the only runtime authority and the Tribunal still certifies every path

model.night_forcing: the correction is forced to zero when there is no clear sky
model.features: model means, clear-sky level, the model's own expected ratio, lags, hour/doy harmonics, the previous correction (never the same-time measurement)

gates.name: GATE: >= 1 % validation MAE improvement from the residual
gates.observed: 0.000 % (8,624 W at w = 0 vs 8,624 W at the best w)
gates.note: The ridge explains 2.5 % of the residual variance (R^2 vs the mean): the clearness innovation is not predictable at a 15-minute horizon, so there is nothing for the chamber to correct.

gates.name: The weight stays at or near zero
gates.target: w <= 0.20 and the selection picks w ~ 0

gates.name: The governor is the only runtime authority
gates.target: the residual weight applied at run time is the governor's effective weight
gates.observed: the pipeline sets the governor weight from the selection and the genesis uses governor.get_effective_w(); the Tribunal certifies every path afterwards

gates.name: Night forcing
gates.target: the correction is ~0 when there is no clear sky
gates.observed: the residual is zeroed wherever the clear sky is below 1 W, so it cannot invent night power

allowed: The residual chamber is bounded, governed, Tribunal-checked and leakage-safe.
Its weight is selected on the 2022 validation window and is now 0.
The clearness innovation is not predictable at this horizon (R^2 = 0.025).
forbidden: Any claim that the residual improves the forecast: the selected weight is 0.
Any claim that the residual is a control path: it never bypasses the Tribunal.

notes: The chamber gained two things in W4: the residual's own lag as a feature (the correction proposed for the previous step, never the realised measurement) and a hard night forcing.
Because the selected weight is 0, the operational scenarios are bit-identical to the W2 baseline.
